name: Calm landscapes
description: Quiet fields, rivers, coasts, gardens and skies from three centuries of painting, chosen to sit gently behind a family dashboard all day.

works.alt_text: A green summer meadow with scattered trees and a distant barn under a clearing sky, a pale rainbow arching down on the right.
A pale blue sea at low tide shimmering in sunlight, with a green headland and white cliffs in the distance.
Two rowing boats, one blue and one green, resting on the grassy bank of a calm tidal creek with houses beyond.
A wide valley of autumn trees in red and gold stretching toward distant blue mountains under a soft sky.
A broad, still river with fishermen in small boats, sailing boats and a distant church tower beneath a large cloudy sky.
A pale ink painting of misty sandbanks and reeds with a line of geese descending, and calligraphy at the top right.
A small house with a red roof half hidden behind pale, blossoming trees under a light spring sky.
A calm river at dusk with a fisherman in a boat and ducks on the water, tall trees on the left and a pale pink sky.
A grassy park lawn with rounded shrubs and a weeping tree under a yellow-green sky.
A quiet snow-covered garden with bare winter trees, low walls and a distant house, one figure walking under a pale grey-blue sky.
A tall rock rising from a calm sea in soft pink evening light, with a sailing ship far off and a small rowing boat.
A riverside road with houses and a horse-drawn cart beside a calm river, under a blue sky with white clouds.
A calm river winding between autumn trees, with two people in a rowing boat, under a blue sky full of white clouds.
A green sea flecked with small waves, dotted with dark-sailed fishing boats out to the horizon under a pale grey sky.
A wide river valley with a pale lake between low reddish hills and broad fields below a blue sky with clouds.
A sunny town street with a few walkers, white houses with blue-grey roofs and a pink brick wall beneath a pale blue sky.
